newsitem.title: USA: Nautilus Pipeline files to build Ship Shoal line.
newsitem.headline: Nautilus Pipeline files to build Ship Shoal line.

text.p: Nautilus Pipeline Co LLC has filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to construct and operate the Nautilus natural gas pipeline serving the Ship Shoal area of the Gulf of Mexico, the project sponsors said Thursday.

They now expect Nautilus to commence service in November 1997. Nautilus was formed by affiliates of USX-Marathon Group's Marathon Oil Co, the Royal Dutch/Shell Group's Shell Oil Co and Leviathan Gas Pipeline Partners LP.
Monday, September 16th marked the first day of an Open Season which will run through October 31, during which potential shippers may request capacity on the Nautilus system.
Nautilus will be located in the central Gulf of Mexico, offshore Louisiana and will be a new interstate pipeline system which will consist of 101 miles of 30-inch pipe.
It will extend from Ship Shoal Block 207 to natural gas plants in the South Bend, La., area, including the Burns Point and Exxon Corp Garden City natural gas plants.
